results.name: C1 fill+stroke at ca=CA=.5 is a knockout pair: interior = fill over backdrop, stroke over backdrop (not over fill)
C1b the same knockout pair straight on the (transparent) page, nothing under it: identical result once the paper goes under
C2 fill+stroke with BM Difference over white: both halves are the complement (yellow → blue)
C3 page backdrop is transparent: Difference straight on the page (nothing under it) is Normal; paper goes under afterwards
C4 blend Multiply: cyan × yellow = green; Screen: red ⊕ blue = magenta
C5 Luminosity soft mask: mask group paints gray .5 → red at 50% over white = (255,128,128)
C6 Luminosity /BC: empty mask group over BC [1] → mask 1 (full red); without /BC the backdrop is black → nothing painted
C7 Luminosity mask in a DeviceCMYK group with no /BC: backdrop = zero components = WHITE → mask 1
C8 Alpha soft mask: mask group paints at ca .25 → red at 25% over white = (255,191,191)
C9 soft mask /TR: an inverting transfer function maps luminosity 1 → 0 → nothing painted
C10 group alpha: two overlapping OPAQUE rects in a group drawn at ca .5 → overlap is blue at 50% (not blue over red)
C11 isolated knockout group: blue at .5 knocks out red at .5 → overlap = blue .5 over white (PDFium ignores /K: (128,64,191))
C12 non-isolated knockout group over a black backdrop: knocked-out area returns to the BACKDROP, not to transparent
C13 nested group inside a knockout group knocks out by its SHAPE: inner group of blue at .5 → overlap blue .5 over white
C14 negative: a soft mask whose group is not a stream, a mask cycle-depth bomb and /SMask /None all render without throwing
C15 /Matte: an image premultiplied against matte black, α .5, un-premultiplies to its true colour
C16 non-isolated group over a SEMI-TRANSPARENT backdrop (transparent page): the backdrop is not counted twice
C17 (TT78) a clip the page leaves active — W n, W before the path, unbalanced q — never clips the paper
